title: SWAP5 Documentation & Review Baseline

F_DOC16.role: Qualified historical conceptual foundation for physical-system scope and 1D-column abstraction; current admission/status claims rebound to Status-A.

F_DOC18.role: Restricted physical/formal source for reference Richards, ET/root and surface-evaporation lineage; F-DOC17 explicitly says it is not current-canonical authority.

F_DOC13.role: Bounded temporal/numerical lineage with explicit nonclaim of a general nonlinear true-error theorem.

F_DOC17.role: Useful classification/reconciliation history; its pre-Status-A compliance conclusion is not current status.

STATUS_A_DOCS.role: Controls frozen Status-A scope, architecture and distributed theory-code-evidence traceability.

legacy_equivalence_reconciliation.reason: Complete canonical SWAP5 application-level mapping for the long Hupsel legacy input/crop/ET composition is not yet fixed; this is an experimental prerequisite gap, not a discovered unexplained numerical difference.

current_update_slice.practical_entry_finding: The repository has a qualified minimal application-host contract and deterministic owner runner, but no current authority for a single broad stable end-user SWAP5 CLI or replacement universal input/output grammar.
current_update_slice.documentation_completion_rule: Missing but reconstructable documentation is written from accepted theory/code/evidence; missing unproven authority is recorded as a gap and is not invented.

publication_risk.rule: Do not publish the colleague-review portal until the workflow deploy source is an explicit frozen review publication authority and the site itself displays both scientific and documentation git authorities.

next_actions: Design generated Fortran source-reference integration without displacing the human review hierarchy.
Create/freeze the publication authority and update the Pages workflow away from stale-main-only publication.
Run strict docs qualification and external publication verification before CLOSE.
explicit_nonclaims: No production or reference source is modified by F-DOC20.
Historical F-DOC branches are not silently promoted to current canonical authority.
The review portal does not claim complete whole-application SWAP 4.3.1/SWAP5 equivalence before that experiment is validly executed.
Post-Status-A capability development remains outside the first frozen scientific review denominator unless explicitly added before a later freeze.
Capability documentation does not broaden admitted Restart, MultiSWAP, WOFOST, Snow, drainage or groundwater semantics.
Internal qualification runners are not represented as a broad stable end-user SWAP5 application interface.
